global_group.verdict: No framing convention enlarges the continuous target-preserving group.

infinitesimal.equations: X_i[d,c]=0 for d!=c, and sum_i X_i[c,c]=0 for c=0,1,2

intrinsic_rank_one_locus.consequence: A GHZ stabilizer permutes these three intrinsic lines for every site pair. Pairwise consistency forces one common permutation at all eight sites.
intrinsic_rank_one_locus.two_site_contraction_space: D_ij=span(e_(i,0)tensor e_(j,0), e_(i,1)tensor e_(j,1), e_(i,2)tensor e_(j,2))

exact_stable_but_728_carrier_blocked_con.scope: This is an exact 728-carrier no-cap negative control, but it is outside X4 (78 level-four failures), hence not a counterexample to the target conjecture. It proves that framed cyclic stability alone has no formal implication to the carrier cap criterion.

king_HN_audit.cap_mismatch: A clean cap is a nonzero K in the kernel of a 90x9 or 108x9 response matrix with four activity forms nonzero. It is not a site subspace preserved by the 28 edge maps, so no King/HN subrepresentation canonically produces K or an N8->N6 descent.
king_HN_audit.cyclic_framed_stability: If the three local GHZ frame vectors are used as generating framings, they already span every V_i. Any subrepresentation containing the framing is the whole representation, independent of all 28 edge tensors; cyclic stability is therefore vacuous.
king_HN_audit.king_criterion_if_ordinary: For a dimension vector d and character theta with theta.d=0, theta-semistability is the sign condition on theta(dim W) for every quiver subrepresentation W; HN uses the induced slopes.
king_HN_audit.reason: There is no source-faithful ordinary quiver action, and the framed GHZ equation supplies no distinguished nonzero King character. On the actual stabilizer, theta=0 is the natural choice and gives no destabilizing filtration.

ordinary_quiver_obstruction.edge_tensor_as_map: V_i tensor V_j = Hom(V_i^*,V_j), transforming as g_j A g_i^T
ordinary_quiver_obstruction.ordinary_arrow_action: A:i->j transforms as g_j A g_i^-1
ordinary_quiver_obstruction.required_vertex_dualization: Every physical edge would have to join one primal and one dual site vertex.
ordinary_quiver_obstruction.verdict: The K8 tensor representation is not an ordinary quiver representation with one GL(V_i) vertex per site. A doubled primal/dual quiver requires the involution constraint g_(i,-)=g_(i,+)^(-T), so ordinary King subrepresentations and independent vertex base changes are not source-faithful.

prior_torus_HM_terminal.minimal_310_face_verdict: Every admissible 1-PS has weight zero on every one of the 48 live X cells. Thus 187 records have only u=0; the other 123 have only support-fixing stabilizer directions. No record has a nontrivial contracting face.

source_faithful_tensor_model.hafnian_map: H:E -> tensor_(i=0)^7 V_i, homogeneous degree four
source_faithful_tensor_model.literal_certificate: Every one of the 105 matching summands contains each site factor exactly once.

terminal_theory_verdict.cheapest_remaining_route: Use response-kernel/tail algebra directly, or prove a non-toric initial-ideal/support descent compatible with the 728 rank strata; quiver HN adds no source-faithful mechanism.
terminal_theory_verdict.reason: The actual target stabilizer is exactly the previously audited 21-dimensional torus up to common S3. The edge tensors are not an ordinary K8-quiver representation, and full GHZ framing makes standard cyclic stability vacuous.
